name: Qwen3-Coder-Next-Opus-4.6-Reasoning-Distilled
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next: 12 full GQA layers (kv heads 2, head_dim 256) and 36 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. Full-parameter SFT (all weights, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 on 8x H100) of Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next on 3,204 Claude-Opus-4.6 and Qwen reasoning traces, with think tags required. Recorded as a contender because the card prints a Base Model vs Opus Distilled column pair for all 26 tests: overall 7.35 -> 7.73, driven by tool calling 3.4 -> 7.2 and bug detection 8.4 -> 9.0, while the base keeps probability, logic and instruction following. THE EVIDENCE IS NOT A PUBLIC BENCHMARK: it is a 26-test hand-written suite scored 1-10 by Claude Opus 4.6 as judge, so it measures judged response quality on the author's own test set and is not comparable to HumanEval, SWE-bench or LiveCodeBench numbers elsewhere in this catalog. Treat the overall 7.73 as an LLM-judge score, not a pass rate. Params: the HF API reports 79.67B in parameters.BF16 while safetensors.total reports only 6.2M, because the index is partially populated; the 79.674B figure is the one used. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-02.

benchmarks.name: Tool Calling (Opus-4.6 judge, 5 tests)
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Category | Base Model | Opus Distilled |': Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-Next 3.4 vs this model 7.2 (+3.8). Graded 1-10 by Claude Opus 4.6 on correctness, completeness, clarity, instruction adherence, across 26 hand-written tests in 6 categories. Not a public benchmark.

benchmarks.name: Bug Detection (Opus-4.6 judge, 5 tests)
benchmarks.config: Same table: base 8.4 vs 9.0 (+0.6). 1-10 LLM-judge score, 5 tests.

benchmarks.name: Coding (Opus-4.6 judge, 6 tests)
benchmarks.config: Same table: base 8.2 vs 8.5 (+0.3). 1-10 LLM-judge score, 6 tests (Python/Rust/TypeScript/SQL).

benchmarks.name: Overall (26 tests, Opus-4.6 judge)
benchmarks.config: Same table 'Overall' row: base 7.35 vs 7.73 (+0.38). The average of all six category scores, three of which the base wins.

benchmarks.name: Probability (Opus-4.6 judge, 5 tests)
benchmarks.config: Same table, a LOSS recorded as measured: base 8.6 vs 8.0 (-0.6). The distill made more arithmetic slips, e.g. a Markov-chain steady-state error.

benchmarks.name: Logic (Opus-4.6 judge, 2 tests)
benchmarks.config: Same table, a LOSS: base 8.5 vs 7.5 (-1.0). Card attributes it to token budget spent on preamble rather than deduction.

benchmarks.name: Instruction Following (Opus-4.6 judge, 3 tests)
benchmarks.config: Same table, a LOSS: base 7.7 vs 7.0 (-0.7). On 'output ONLY valid JSON' the distilled model emitted 2048 tokens and broke the constraint; base emitted clean 453-token JSON.
